_comment: Column headers -> FELIX fields. Copy this file, delete the fields you don't need, and add any header your export uses that isn't already covered by the importer's own built-in defaults (scripts/import-legacy.mjs merges this file OVER those defaults, so you only need to list headers the defaults get wrong or don't recognize at all). Matching is case-insensitive and trims whitespace, but otherwise exact — check your CSV's actual header row if a column isn't picked up.
